title: 2017 Prairie's low iron railing now matches its photograph
items: The William Armour house at 2017 Prairie now has the low iron railing its photograph shows, on a stone curb close before the barred basement windows on either side of the stoop.
The tall spear fence and gates that stood on the street line, which no picture shows, are gone, so the walk comes straight up to the stoop.
With that, every part of the house's front now matches its photograph.
